name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
research: 12 Nov 2026 fix: the old start/end differed by 45 deg of foot pitch on paper, but the rig's toes do not bend, so the real contact is the toe tip, not the ball: the start foot read as flat and the end toes sank 2 cm into the block. Rigid-foot model (toe tip (0,-0.196,-0.074) from the ankle, ball (0,-0.12,-0.074), heel (0,0.05,-0.07), fitted to cloud floor readings). Seated body from dumbbell_shoulder_press (bench 85, root (0,-0.035,0.494) rot -6): hip L (0.11,-0.085,0.502). Block 0.26 x 0.16 x 0.08 centred (0.12,-0.816): top z 0.08, y -0.896..-0.736. START heel low: foot rot X -15, the sole pivots over the block's back edge (ball on the corner y -0.736): ankle (0.12,-0.601,0.122), toe tip z 0.102, heel z 0.042 (4 cm off the floor, below the block top); knee (0.117,-0.538,0.567), 90 deg. END heel high: foot rot +25, toe tip on the block (z 0.081), ball over the edge: ankle (0.12,-0.659,0.231), heel z 0.189 -> heel rises 15 cm; knee (0.116,-0.516,0.657), 91 deg (knee rises 9 cm, as the thigh lifts off the seat at the knee end). Dumbbell across the lower left thigh, handle 0.10 back from the knee and 0.095 above the thigh line (thigh 0.06 + fist 0.035): start (0.12,-0.425,0.647), end (0.12,-0.389,0.712); plates hang either side of the thigh. Left arm plane 40: start elev 20.6, elbow 70, forearm (-0.514,-0.826,-0.231); end elev 50.8, elbow 89, forearm (-0.787,-0.536,-0.306) (start lands within 5 mm). Right foot flat, right hand on the right thigh (unchanged). Camera yaw 88 = true side view. Only the left calf lit (highlight_side L). S1 Kovacs 2024 (knee 90, -15..+30 deg ankle), S2 StrengthLog. 13 Nov 2026 (pics-fixes): QA: start foot beside the block, the free hand hovered, the far foot stayed on the floor. Now BOTH feet stand on one 0.50 m block moved back to y -0.77 (back edge -0.69, so the ball of each foot is ~3 cm on it in the start and the heel hangs behind it); the legs mirror each other; one dumbbell lies across both lower thighs (plates on the thighs, handle between the knees) and both hands grip its handle overhand (fists +-0.045). Handle centre z: start 0.71 (thigh top ~0.62 + plate radius 0.088), end 0.775 as the knees rise. Both calves lit. Camera 3/4 front-left (yaw 62, pitch 12) so both feet on the block show. 13 Nov 2026 fresh review (look A, 384 px), NOT yet applied because renders were paused for the new look: FAIL - reads as the dumbbell held up at belly height (hammer-curl look), clearly off the thighs in the end. Rest it on the lower thighs nearer the knees (handle about y -0.47 / z 0.70 start, y -0.45 / z 0.77 end, plates pressed ~1 cm into the thigh) and use a truer side camera (about yaw 75) so the contact shows.
